rootCause:
Likely cause: AWS Glue Python jobs are experiencing application-level errors causing repeated job failures in the `/aws-glue/python-jobs/error` log group.

Confidence: high

Supporting evidence: Finding IDs 1c0362e7-8855-457b-bf38-42dc51425a46 and f42fca49-3720-4360-85f1-6d247ae911c9 (both category: application, severity: high) account for 23 of the top errors occurring in `/aws-glue/python-jobs/error` with overlapping time windows from 2026-09-01T15:46:05Z through 2026-09-02T09:59:39Z. Four additional correlated application findings (IDs a76309fc-2946-490e-86e9-d795987a70ae, e446a5e5-8377-4e26-be32-9a7f536e4de5, 36d1096e-132a-46c6-a3b6-d5426cab6d8b) in the same log group show 17 combined occurrences. The category breakdown shows 9 application errors dominate the top 10 findings. The trend data shows concentrated error spikes at 12:00 (7 count) and 10:00 (4 count) buckets.
executiveSummary:
**Issue Summary:**
Yes, there are issues. The biggest problem is application errors (9 findings, with 13 occurrences in the top finding) occurring in the Glue Python jobs error log, classified as high severity. Issues are concentrated across 6 affected groups with a recurring pattern: spikes at 12:00 (7 findings), 14:00 (5 findings), 10:00 (4 findings), and 07:00 (2 findings).

**Immediate Investigation Priority:**
The operator should first investigate the `/aws-glue/python-jobs/error` log group for application errors, focusing on what triggers the recurring daily spikes between 10:00-14:00 and 07:00 hours.
